acceptance_criteria: A valid bounded machine code emitted as err.code survives the Hub /jobs catch as the top-level response code.
When err.code is absent or invalid, a valid bounded err.policyCode survives as the top-level response code.

Malformed, lowercase, whitespace-only, over-64-character, or otherwise non-machine-code values are not propagated by the service and do not become client error codes; the client falls back to HUB_REQUEST_FAILED.
The machine-code contract is explicit and bounded (uppercase snake-style identifier, maximum length 64) and is implemented without parsing raw error text.
Hub client errors do not copy arbitrary response payload fields or secrets.
Existing raw error-message compatibility remains unchanged apart from addition of the optional top-level code field.
src/hub/index.mjs remains CRLF-only and its diff contains only the intended import/helper/catch wiring, not whole-file line-ending churn.
All targeted tests, full deterministic tests, client build, and git diff checks pass.
No local dsh-crew installation, Hub startup, DSH profile mutation, credential access, or real-environment smoke is performed.

The Result Contract uses schema_version 2, records second-precision timezone-aware timeline fields, is stamped by the installed v1.8 validator with --stamp, and accurately reports changed files/tests/risks.
